about.title: About
about.body:
We supply kit to clubs, schools and federations — from a single set to seasonal orders.
We work from a specification: articles, colorways, sizes and branding are locked before quoting.
Prices stay private: a manager prepares a commercial offer for your volume and timeline.

delivery.title: Delivery & lead times
delivery.lead: Indicative timelines — confirmed in the commercial offer
delivery.body:
A typical cycle from specification to dispatch is about three weeks, depending on factory load and branding method.
Delivery across Armenia and pickup from the Yerevan warehouse.
Rush orders and large volumes are agreed separately.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.lead: Reach us by phone, email or the homepage form
contacts.body:
Legal details and the exact warehouse address will be confirmed with the client.
Hours: weekdays, by appointment.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
We collect contact details only to reply to your enquiry and prepare a commercial offer.
We do not share data with third parties except delivery and email providers needed to contact you.
To delete or update your data, email the distributor public address.
The full policy text will be approved with the client.
